ENUGU (PSI 9.6): Governor Peter Mbah officially launched Enugu Air's maiden international route from Akanu Ibiam International Airport to Douala, Cameroon, connecting South-East trade directly to Central Africa.

LAGOS (PSI 9.5): Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu hosted a global climate roundtable on coastline protection, Office of SDGs/LASEMA partnered with UNU-EHS on disaster financing, and Tourism Ministry scheduled an October CBT workshop.

PLATEAU (PSI 9.3): Planning Commissioner Ishaku Maren received the NEC Implementation Monitoring Committee led by Prof. Jerom Andoho to begin a 2-day site inspection tracking social protection and legacy infrastructure.

ZAMFARA (PSI 9.2): Deputy Governor Mani Mummuni chaired the signing of an Air Route Development MoU with XEJet Limited to commence bi-weekly scheduled flights between Gusau International Airport and Abuja from October 2026.

YOBE (PSI 9.1): SSG Dr. Mohammed Goje presented Yobe's PPP investment agenda at UNGA 81, engaged Aliko Dangote on victim support portfolios, met the UN Youth Office, and joined former President Obasanjo for Accra Reset health talks.

BENUE (PSI 8.9): Acting Head of Service Dr. Ihu and ASUTIBS Chairman Dr. Ate Agera signed an MoU committing to full implementation of the approved 25/35 salary structure and arrears payout, resolving the tertiary strike.

NASARAWA (PSI 8.8): Governor Abdullahi Sule addressed the 'Redefining Influence, Accelerating Action' UNGA 81 dialogue in New York alongside Lagos State, calling for subnational climate-risk financing and coastal insurance.

EBONYI (PSI 8.7): Governor Francis Nwifuru opened a 3-day capacity building workshop in Abakaliki for LGA Chairmen and Treasurers, mandating strict fiscal prudence under the People's Charter of Needs Agenda.

EDO (PSI 8.6): Pension Bureau Permanent Secretary Washington Abbe assured civil servants migrated from CPS to Defined Benefit Scheme of an 8% contribution refund, while explaining PENCOM PIN reconciliation delays.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.5): Governor Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri swore in Bramsy Samuel Caleb as Energy Development Commissioner and Isa Alhaji Hamidu as SSA, issuing strict directives against financial recklessness and nepotism.

NIGER (PSI 8.4): Governor Umaru Bago inaugurated a 9-man Judicial Commission of Inquiry chaired by Justice Muhammad S.A. Muhammad to investigate the deaths of 37 miners in NSCDC custody within a 4-week mandate.

FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.3): PDP BoT delegation led by Senator Mao Ohuabunwa visited FCT Minister Nyesom Wike to express condolences over Chief Dan Orbih and passed a vote of confidence in his administrative performance.

ABIA (PSI 8.2): Governor Alex Otti delivered an address at MUSON Centre Lagos advocating indigenous language instruction in early childhood education and celebrating Prof. Okey Ndibe's new mini-biography.
OYO (PSI 8.0): Oyo State Government published comprehensive progress tracking confirming over 900 km of completed and ongoing road projects connecting rural and urban communities across the state.
